text:
maya: FYI I enabled sentinel15b.int4 with session_kv_persist=true on the chat-assistant route (canary 8%). Early signals: big token-cost wins but a clear drop in session-consistency for multi-turn sessions that keep state across 4+ turns.

rick: Ugh. Can you paste a sanitized failing convo and the traffic/profile numbers?

maya: Example (sanitized):
```
TURN1 USER: Summarize project goals from doc.
TURN1 BOT_FP16: Goals include A (owner: Lina), B (owner: Marco).
TURN2 USER: Who owns B? (session context used)
BOT_FP16: Marco.
BOT_INT4: Lina.  // owner attributed to wrong person in session
```
Meta: avg_session_turns=4.6, tokens_in/session ~5200, session_kv_persist=true, canary=8%, batch=1. p50 latency +3% vs int8, p95 ~same. Unit costs (hosted): fp16 ~$0.034/session-request, INT8 ~$0.016, INT4 ~$0.006.

eval-bot: Automated alert: session-consistency fail rate rose 0.9% -> 5.7% on sentinel15b.int4 (threshold 2%). kv_session_stability delta -1.4%.

clara: Sounds like low-bit accumulation across session KV writes is drifting attention keys over many turns. Session-level persistence + long token chains amplify tiny quantization errors. Disabling session_kv_persist for int4 in staging reduced regressions ~1.8pt, but didn't close gap.

sam: For a quick ops mitigation I propose: route_by_session where condition = session_turns OR session_kv_persist. Pseudoconfig: 
```
policy: route_by_session
conditions:
  - if: session_turns >= 4
    route: sentinel15b.int8
  - if: session_kv_persist == true
    route: sentinel15b.int8
  - else: sentinel15b.int4
```
Also add a soft-sample shadow: 10% of int4 sessions are shadowed to int8 for drift scoring and to compute live session_consistency deltas.

maya: Good. Adding a per-session metric in console would help: session_consistency_score, kv_session_stability, and a drift_alert counter. Recommend rollback rule: if session_consistency_fail_rate > 3% AND delta_vs_baseline > 1.5% over rolling 30m -> auto-pin to int8.

clara: For GTN/product language: propose a short blurb we can paste in release notes.

rick: Please include expected unit-econ numbers and UX impact in the blurb. Product wants something 1-2 sentences.

maya: Draft GTN blurb: "Recommendation: Use INT4 as the default for short-lived, single-turn chat interactions to capture ~60-65% unit-cost savings vs INT8. For persistent multi-turn sessions that rely on session state (turns >=4 or session_kv_persist=true), route to INT8 by default to avoid measurable session-consistency regressions. Unit-econ snapshot: fp16 ~$0.034, INT8 ~$0.016, INT4 ~$0.006 per typical high-token session; misrouting risk: session-level consistency errors visible in ~4-7% of long sessions if left on INT4."

sam: Ops rollout checklist: 1) implement routing policy behind feature flag; 2) enable 10% shadow sampling to int8 for drift scoring; 3) run 48h A/B smoke targeting sessions with turns>=4 at 8% traffic; 4) monitor session_consistency_score, kv_session_stability, p95 latency, and mem usage; 5) rollback/pin to int8 automatically on drift rule.

clara: Also add a product-facing "accuracy mode" session toggle that forces session to int8 for the duration. That gives customers an explicit knob and avoids surprises.

maya: I'll open the routing PR + runbook and attach failing examples + eval diffs. Tagging @rick for product wording and @sam for rollout ops. :eyes:

eval-bot: Scheduling 48h A/B smoke: sentinel15b.int8 vs sentinel15b.int4; slices: session-consistency (turns>=4), long-session-entities, multi-turn-timeline.

rick: Thanks team. If smoke is clean we'll keep int4 as default for ephemeral chats and gate session-accuracy flows to int8. Please hold GTN announcement until the smoke completes and add per-session telemetry to the dashboard.

maya: Will do. eval-bot: Reaction :white_check_mark: scheduled.
